items.heading: Nsima with Ndiwo
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, water, leafy greens, dried fish
Cook corn meal with water into a thick, smooth dough (nsima).
Simmer leafy greens with tomato and onion.
Add dried fish or beans to the greens for protein.
Serve the nsima alongside the vegetable relish.

items.heading: Malawian Chambo Fish
details: Key ingredients: chambo fish, tomato, onion, lemon
Clean and season a whole chambo fish with lemon.
Fry or grill the fish until golden and cooked through.
Prepare a light tomato and onion relish.
Serve the fish topped with the relish and nsima on the side.

items.heading: Nsima
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
